scope: Universal texture-cache allocation correctness, no game or shader-hash conditions
upstream_integration: The complete two-file upstream #5524 change is already semantically present in retained source: constexpr Contains uses levels>= and layers>= and all three corrected callsites exist. Runner proves the entire official old/new delta consists only of those additions/replacements and verifies retained file blobs. It creates an explicit merge preserving the retained tree byte-for-byte before applying the new correction. No arbitrary conflict resolution or replacement of other retained fixes.
new_defect: ResolveDepthOverlap recreates an image using std::max on SubresourceExtent. Default ordering is lexicographic; requested 1 mip/6 layers plus cached 8 mips/1 layer produces 8 mips/1 layer, not the extent covering both. The previously added containment check does not fix this allocation.
new_correction: Select levels=max(requested.levels,cached.levels) and layers=max(requested.layers,cached.layers) before UpdateSize. Assert containment of both extents. Preserve the existing refresh, copy, usage and retirement paths. Emit at most 16 DepthExtentMerge messages only when crossed dimensions differ from the old whole-extent selection.
